$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the skills list. `displayed` + `external` appear on /skills, grouped under `categories` IN THAT ORDER and, within a category, IN THE ORDER LISTED HERE (scripts/generate-skills-content.mjs builds the page data from the skill files). Each shown skill names its category in its frontmatter (`category: <id>`); a skill in the `recurring` category also carries a `cadence`. `unlisted` are internal-only. Every .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md must be registered here; external skills keep their published copy in website/src/data/external-skills/<name>.md. scripts/validate-skills-registry.mjs enforces all of this at build time.

categories.label: Build
categories.description: Add something new to the system: a component, a token, a theme, a page, a validator. Each one names every file and registry the addition has to reach.

categories.label: Review
categories.description: Audits and sweeps. Each one reads the system against a rule set, reports what it found, and fixes what is plainly broken.

categories.label: Ship
categories.description: Move work between a branch, main, the live site and npm. Each skill is named for where the work ends up.

categories.label: Figma
categories.description: Keep the Figma kit in step with the code. The code is the source of truth, so every change lands on the Figma side.

categories.label: Recurring
categories.description: Checks worth repeating on a cadence. Nothing schedules them yet: each runs when asked, and ends with fixes on a local branch waiting for approval.
